title: jev-chat/jev-chat-jarvis
why_read: A screen-reading chat auto-reply assistant for messaging apps, technically modest and raising real privacy and platform-terms concerns.
analysis: This tool reads on-screen chat content in apps like QQ, X, and Feishu to suggest and auto-fill reply candidates, explicitly advertising that it does not hook or modify the host app and only reads the screen. Technically this is a fairly standard screen-scraping plus LLM-suggestion pattern rather than a novel technical contribution. It raises real questions about violating platform terms of service and about the ethics of automating personal conversations without recipients' knowledge. It's a product more than an engineering advance, with limited transferable technical insight for a professional digest.
